name: Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
−2: Target artifact you control becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature you control until end of turn, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
blocked_sentences: −2: Target artifact you control becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature you control until end of turn, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

needs.what: an `add_types` exception on `become_copy`'s `except_` (707.9b), so an in-place copy effect can write "except it's an artifact in addition to its other types" into the copiable values: `{"op": "become_copy", "objects": {"target": "t1"}, "copying": {"target": "t2"}, "duration": "end_of_turn", "except_": {"add_types": ["Artifact"]}}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `become_copy`'s `except_` accepts only `add_keywords` and `keep_abilities` (the loader's BECOME_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS), and op_become_copy explicitly resets `copying_add_types` to None even though the object field and `state.card_of` already support it (zones.py fills it for as-enters copies). `copy_permanent` takes `add_types` but makes a new token instead of altering the target; `animate`/`add_subtype` granted afterwards would be a separate layer-4 effect rather than part of the copiable values, so a creature copy would stop being an artifact the wrong way. Without the exception, copying a creature drops the Artifact type, which changes the card.
